{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data types and check for issues
print("Revenue type before parsing:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed only
completed_cleaned = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_parsed'].mean()

print("Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning):", mean_revenue)"}
